flags.summary: The party has met Ismark at the Blood of the Vine; he moves to the mansion.
Someone (Arik or the Vistani) told the party Ismark's nickname, 'the Lesser'.
Ismark, pressed for payment, offered the burgomaster's strongbox.
The burgomaster's strongbox in the mansion study has been opened.
Ismark or Ireena has remarked on the strongbox being opened without leave.
The party has spoken with Ireena in the mansion.
Ireena opened the barred mansion door to the party before Ismark vouched for them.
A party member saw the two bite marks on Ireena's neck (Phase 4 reads).
Tamsin showed Ireena the locket: the portrait has her face (Phase 4+ reads; Tatyana).
Ilse showed Ismark the letter signed with an S; Strahd remarks on it at the burial.
The party agreed to help bury the burgomaster.
The party has spoken with Father Donavich.
Father Donavich agreed to say the burial rites.
Father Donavich refuses to bury the burgomaster (Doru was destroyed against his wishes).
Donavich has reacted to Doru being destroyed or freed.
Donavich gave the party leave to destroy Doru as a mercy (Phase 5 reads).
Donavich refused the party's plea to end Doru's suffering.
Donavich gave the party two flasks of holy water.
The church vestry chest (holy water, candles) has been opened.
Donavich lifted the bar on the undercroft door.
Donavich admitted the voice under the church is his son Doru.
The party spoke with Doru in the undercroft.
Doru the vampire spawn was destroyed (encounter doru_undercroft) (Phase 5 reads).
The party let Doru out of the undercroft; he fled toward the castle (Phase 4 reads).
The party chose to leave Doru locked in the undercroft (Phase 5 reads).
The party promised Donavich to look for a way to save Doru (Phase 5 reads).
Donavich told the party of the Holy Symbol of Ravenkind (Phase 4 reads).
The coffin has left the mansion for the churchyard; NPCs move to the grave.
Parriwimple (hired or befriended) carries the coffin and digs the grave.
The party was kind to Parriwimple; he'll help for free.
How the burgomaster was buried: church_rites, cleric_rites, lay_rites or hasty (Phase 4 reads).
Kolyan Indirovich is buried in the churchyard (Phase 4 reads).
Strahd appeared in person at the burial (Phase 4 reads).
The party's answer to Strahd at the grave: defiant, courteous, violent or silent; unset if Doru carried the message (Phase 4+ reads).
The party defeated the churchyard dead (encounter churchyard_dead).
The party chose to stand watch at the mansion; triggers encounter mansion_siege.
The party held the mansion through the night (encounter mansion_siege).
Ireena's escort decision: accepted, later or declined (Phase 4 reads).
Where the party agreed to take Ireena: vallaki or krezk (Phase 4 reads).
Ireena travels with the party as a guest (Phase 4 reads; the engine adds the guest).
Ismark travels with the party and Ireena as a guest (Phase 4 reads).
The party set out west from the village (Phase 4 reads).
The party has spoken with the Vistani women in the tavern.
The Vistani women told the party about Madam Eva at Tser Pool (Phase 4 reads).
The party bought the Vistani women a bottle.
The party noticed the Vistani women are watching them for someone (Phase 4 reads).
Arik said the Wizard of Wines deliveries have stopped (Phase 5 reads).
An Insight check showed there is nobody behind Arik's eyes.
The party read Aurel Mirescu's last note in the tavern's back room (Phase 4 reads).
The party met Morgantha and her pastry cart.
How many dream pastries the party bought from Morgantha (Phase 5 reads).
A party member ate Morgantha's sample and dreamed (Phase 5 reads).
The party saw through Morgantha (Insight or Medicine) (Phase 5 reads).
The party intimidated Morgantha out of the village; she remembers (Phase 5 reads).
The party learned Morgantha bakes at the old windmill on the Vallaki road (Phase 5 reads).
The party has spoken with Mad Mary.
The party promised Mary to look for Gertruda (Phase 6 reads).
The party found that Gertruda's window latch was opened from the inside.
The party has been into Bildrath's Mercantile.
The party out-haggled Bildrath: ten percent off the kit and the potion.
Bildrath refused to haggle; he won't entertain it again.
The party bought Bildrath's one potion of healing.
The mercantile strongbox was opened (Phase 4 can read for reputation).
Bildrath has confronted the party about the strongbox.
Bildrath threw the party out for theft.
The party repaid Bildrath's thirty gold.
The party cleared the dead from the square at night (encounter night_streets_dead).
Kolyan Indirovich was raised from his grave by the party (the horseman card's ally, Phase 5).
A failed Intimidation haggle at Bildrath's (bildrath): he puts ten percent on the dear things for the rest of the game (the healer's kit at 55 gp, the potion at 550 gp).
The party failed to bully Ireena into opening the mansion door (ireena: door). She remembers the voice when they first meet in the parlour.

The party failed to frighten Morgantha's cart out of the village (morgantha). She remembers: a mocking greeting on the lane and at the mill, and the children cost 200 gp instead of 150 at Old Bonegrinder.
Ismark gave the party his father's +1 longsword at the grave after the burial (ismark: after_burial, docs/story/found_magic_items.md).
The party sang for the Vistani women in the Blood of the Vine (vistani: perform_ok / perform_fail). On a success Sorvia gave them a Deck of Illusions; either way the option is spent.
